name: German Kontoauszug
description: German bank statement (Kontoauszug). Detects IBAN, BIC/SWIFT, Bankleitzahl (BLZ), Kontonummer, German dates, German phones and addresses, plus names and account holders. Amounts kept visible so you can prove income while redacting identities — toggle 'Amounts' manually to hide balances too.

patterns.name: IBAN
patterns.description: International Bank Account Number, with or without spaces between groups.

patterns.name: BIC / SWIFT
patterns.description: Bank identifier code, 8 or 11 characters, matched with its BIC or SWIFT label.

patterns.name: BLZ
patterns.description: Bankleitzahl (German bank sort code): 8 digits, matched with its label (BLZ, Bankleitzahl).

patterns.name: Kontonummer
patterns.description: German account number: 6-10 digits, matched with its label (Kontonummer, Konto-Nr., Kto.-Nr.).
